name: Lian'ai, Chuangye, Hehuoren
source:
[quote]"Let's start a company!"[/quote]
After graduating from university, you fail to find a job and have nowhere to go. At your roommate’s suggestion, you are pulled into an unprepared startup plan: no experience, no resources, no salary, and only the rough idea for an unfinished AI-girlfriend app.

You must make choices with limited time, money, and energy: start a company, develop an AI product, and build a team; or give up on unrealistic fantasies, continue job hunting, enter a major corporation, and become a stable but gradually numb office worker.

The five heroines are not only romanceable characters, but also your partners, coworkers, and unavoidable relationships in your life. Career choices will change intimate relationships, while emotional bonds will also influence the path of your startup.

What will you choose? Set out on an adventure and build together!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4909210/Love_Startup__Cofounder/?l=english]Steam[/url]]
